title: NPM 3 Flat node_modules Breaks CLI
description: cli and appc-cli-titanium, at the very least, have paths inside of them that depend on nested node_modules. With npm 3, all of the dependencies and their dependencies are flatly stored in the one node_modules directory, which breaks these references in our code. We need to be less brittle with these references.    To reproduce, I am able to simply `appc use 5.2.0-155`, then try to do something like `appc ti clean` and you should see an error about not being able to find `node_modules/appc-cli-titanium/node_modules/titanium/bin/titanium`.
